title: Increase Services selected card element background opacity to ~20%

requirements.summary: Increase the white background fill opacity to ~20% (Tailwind `bg-white/20`) for only the 13 user-specified elements in the Services section service cards, without modifying any other elements or overlays.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the 13 specified elements have their white overlay/background opacity changed to ~20% (e.g., Tailwind `bg-white/20`).
No other elements in the Services section (including the full-card gradient overlay) are modified.
No other sections/pages/components are visually or structurally changed.
Service-card text readability improves due to the stronger (less transparent) white box fill on the selected elements.

file_operations.description: Update Tailwind classes so only the DOM nodes corresponding to the 13 provided XPaths get `bg-white/20` instead of the current ~`bg-white/5`. Implement via index-based conditional class application on the specific elements that map to those XPaths (e.g., keep Card gradient overlay and all non-target `bg-white/5` elements unchanged), ensuring no other Services section elements are altered. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
